Decision: Selected customer segmentation as the primary lens
Options_Considered: Customer segmentation; product association; customer value and retention
Reason: The transaction data supports customer-level behavioural profiling through engineered purchasing features
Evidence: The dataset contains CustomerID, InvoiceDate, Quantity, and UnitPrice variables
Impact: Defines the main unit of analysis and modeling strategy

Decision: Selected product association and bundling as the secondary lens
Options_Considered: No secondary lens; overall association mining; segment-specific association mining
Reason: This directly strengthens the primary lens by producing product recommendations for suitable customer segments
Evidence: InvoiceNo and StockCode support basket construction while CustomerID connects baskets to customer segments
Impact: Adds coherent cross-selling and bundling recommendations

Decision: Excluded the raw Excel dataset from Git tracking
Options_Considered: Commit raw data to GitHub; store externally and document access
Selected_Option: Store externally and document the source, path, and fingerprint
Reason: The dataset is publicly available and approximately 23 MB; excluding it keeps the repository lightweight while preserving reproducibility
Evidence: The UCI dataset page, DOI, local path, and SHA-256 fingerprint are documented
Impact: Every member must download and verify the same dataset file

Options_Considered: Use unspecified seeds; use different seeds; use one documented seed
Reason: A fixed seed makes model fitting, sampling, and initial validation results reproducible
Evidence: The same seed can be reused across notebooks and verified by all members
Impact: Improves repeatability while stability will still be assessed using additional seeds
